cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); no reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Coco-Glucoside (9) is after Parfum and is not a buffer under C4; this does not change C1 (one buffer suffices).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Several light routes: prominent hydrolyzed proteins Hydrolyzed Keratin (5) and Hydrolyzed Collagen (6), plus late Glyceryl Oleate (10), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (12), Glycol Distearate (13), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (16) and Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (19). C2 not met (no early silicone, no prominent payload lipid).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Every conditioning agent except the proteins sits after Parfum; the cationic guar is after the fragrance allergens (trace); hydrolyzed proteins give limited slip.
conditioningLevel.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

weightPotential.rationale: Only hydrolyzed proteins are prominent; all other deposition routes are late/trace and face an effective C1 reset.

excluded: PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate (15): PEG thickener (6.4)

depositionLoad.rationale: Proteins (5, 6) are low-MW film routes; guar (19), refatters (10, 12) and waxy lipid (16) are after Parfum.

persistence.rationale: No silicone, no prominent cationic; hydrolyzed proteins rinse largely.

weightRecord.counterevidence: W2: several families are present, but every family other than the hydrolyzed proteins is after Parfum (guar after the fragrance allergens, i.e. trace), the refatters are weak, the waxy lipid is late, and the proteins are low-persistence film routes facing an effective sulfate reset; their combined residue is plausibly below noticeable.
weightRecord.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence; reset is effective.
